title: Map route arc
description: Use to show a journey or shipment between two cities: a great-circle route draws on with a travelling dot (offline).
props: {from?: City /*Lisbon*/; to?: City /*Sao Paulo*/; landColor?: string; strokeColor?: string; routeColor?: string /*'#fbbf24'*/; textColor?: string; startFrame?: number /*12*/; durationInFrames?: number /*45*/; fontFamily?: string} // City = {name: string; lon: number; lat: number}
example:
import {MapRouteArc} from './blocks/map-route-arc/MapRouteArc.tsx';
<MapRouteArc from={{name: "Paris", lon: 2.35, lat: 48.86}} to={{name: "Tokyo", lon: 139.7, lat: 35.7}} />
